verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical. In both, the 'Biggest Plants' headline is too small for a tall story format. A big white area sits to the right of the top image, the rule line and dot clusters float with no purpose, and 'WORLD'S' is separated from the headline. B moves everything up, which leaves an even bigger blank band at the bottom (about 90px) and a lopsided layout. A spreads the vertical space a little more evenly, but it has its own awkward gap under the top black bar.
